chunks: And Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
"Purchase black, unattractive camels, for they have the longest lifespans among camels."

key_terms.ٱلسُّودَ: The black ones; referring to black camels

ai.seo_question: Which camels did Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام recommend purchasing?
ai.summary: This hadith relays practical guidance from Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام regarding the selection of camels for purchase. It indicates that black, unattractive camels are known for longer lifespans, highlighting a useful worldly consideration in livestock choice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Purchase black, unattractive camels, for they have the longest lifespans among camels."
